author: Cleo Abram
description:
Why does the ball for this year’s World Cup not LOOK like a regular soccer ball?

Turns out, that difference really changes how the ball performs, and there’s a THIRD design that’s even more controversial.
 
The trick is figuring out how to  create a SPHERE out of a FLAT material

But there’s also a secret sensor inside this ball! To see it, subscribe!

#worldcup #fifa #soccer #football #trionda #physics
title: Why The World Cup Ball Looks Like That
